translations.EN: I couldn't set up camp there.
translations.TL: Hindi ako nakapag-set up ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: Failed to establish camp. That spot wasn't viable.
translations.TL: Bigo sa pagtatayo ng kampo. Di angkop ang lugar.

translations.EN: I tried to camp there, but it didn't work out.
translations.TL: Sinubukan kong magkampo roon, pero hindi umubra.

translations.EN: Couldn't secure that position for a camp.
translations.TL: Hindi ma-secure ang pwestong 'yon para sa kampo.

translations.EN: Camp setup failed. The area is too exposed.
translations.TL: Pumalpak ang pagtatayo ng kampo. Masyadong bukas ang lugar.

translations.EN: Unable to bed down there. Too many issues.
translations.TL: Di makatulog doon. Masyadong maraming aberya.

translations.EN: That campsite didn't pan out. Too dangerous.
translations.TL: Di umubra ang kampong 'yon. Masyadong mapanganib.

translations.EN: Attempted to camp, but had to pull out.
translations.TL: Sinubukang magkampo, pero kinailangang umurong.

translations.EN: Can't pitch camp there. Ground wasn't secure.
translations.TL: Di makapaglatag ng kampo roon. Di ligtas ang lupa.

translations.EN: Camping attempt failed. Finding another spot.
translations.TL: Bigo ang pagtatangkang magkampo. Maghanap ng iba.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll set up camp there.
translations.TL: Sige, magse-set up ako ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: Understood. Setting up our camp now.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Itatayo na ang kampo natin ngayon.

translations.EN: I'll go get the camp established.
translations.TL: Pupunta ako para itayo ang kampo.

translations.EN: On my way to set up camp.
translations.TL: Papunta na para magtayo ng kampo.

translations.EN: Making camp in that spot. Understood.
translations.TL: Magtatayo ng kampo sa pwestong 'yon. Naintindihan.

translations.EN: Right. Setting up shelter over there.
translations.TL: Sige. Magtatayo ng silungan doon.

translations.EN: I'll secure the camp site now.
translations.TL: Seselyuhan ko ang kampo ngayon.

translations.EN: Moving to establish camp as ordered.
translations.TL: Kikilos para magtayo ng kampo ayon sa utos.

translations.EN: Got it. Pitching camp.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko. Maglalatag ng kampo.

translations.EN: Understood. Heading over to make camp.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Pupunta roon para magkampo.

translations.EN: Sure, I'll set up camp there. Sounds cozy.
translations.TL: Sige, magse-set up ako ng kampo roon. Mukhang maaliwalas.

translations.EN: Happy to! Let's get a good fire going.
translations.TL: Masayang gagawin! Magpaningas tayo ng maayos na apoy.

translations.EN: Good call, friend. I'll get our camp ready.
translations.TL: Magandang pasya, kaibigan. Ihahanda ko ang kampo.

translations.EN: Leave it to me! I'll make sure it's safe and comfortable.
translations.TL: Ipaubaya mo sa akin! Titiyakin kong ligtas at komportable.

translations.EN: Great idea. I'll go set up camp for us.
translations.TL: Magandang ideya. Pupunta ako para itayo ang kampo natin.

translations.EN: Right on! Time to get off our feet. Setting up now.
translations.TL: Aba oo! Oras na para magpahinga. Magtatayo na ngayon.

translations.EN: Gladly. I'll have the beds laid out shortly.
translations.TL: Malugod kong gagawin. Ilalatag ko ang higaan maya-maya.

translations.EN: Sounds wonderful. I'll get our shelter squared away.
translations.TL: Napakaganda. Aayusin ko ang silungan natin.

translations.EN: Sure thing, partner! Camp will be ready in no time.
translations.TL: Walang anuman, kasama! Handa na ang kampo agad.

translations.EN: On it, friend! Rest easy, I'll handle camp.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso na, kaibigan! Magpahinga ka, ako na sa kampo.

translations.EN: I'm still setting up camp there.
translations.TL: Nagtatayo pa rin ako ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: Already working on the camp. Give me a minute.
translations.TL: Ginagawa ko na ang kampo. Bigyan mo ako ng sandali.

translations.EN: Still on it. Setting up takes a little time.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso pa rin. May katagalan ang pagtatayo.

translations.EN: I'm already pitching the camp there.
translations.TL: Naglalatag na ako ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: Working as fast as I can on that camp.
translations.TL: Ginagawa ko nang mabilis ang kampong 'yon.

translations.EN: Yeah, I heard you the first time. Still making camp.
translations.TL: Oo, narinig ko sa una pa lang. Ginagawa pa rin ang kampo.

translations.EN: I'm already in the middle of setting up.
translations.TL: Kasalukuyan na akong nagtatayo roon.

translations.EN: Camp setup is already in progress.
translations.TL: Kasalukuyan nang isinasagawa ang pagkakampo.

translations.EN: Still securing the campsite. Hold tight.
translations.TL: Sinisigurado pa rin ang kampo. Maghintay lang.

translations.EN: Almost done with the camp. Don't rush me.
translations.TL: Halos tapos na sa kampo. Huwag mo akong madaliin.

translations.EN: All right, I'll make camp there.
translations.TL: Sige, magtatayo ako ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: I trust your eye for good ground. Setting up camp.
translations.TL: Tiwala ako sa pagpili mo ng lupa. Magtatayo ng kampo.

translations.EN: You picked the spot, I'll build the shelter.
translations.TL: Pinili mo ang pwesto, itatayo ko ang silungan.

translations.EN: Understood. I'll make sure our campsite is locked down tight.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Titiyakin kong saradong-sarado ang kampo natin.

translations.EN: I know you've got our safety in mind. Making camp.
translations.TL: Alam kong kaligtasan natin ang iniisip mo. Magkakampo.

translations.EN: Right away. We'll be secure there together.
translations.TL: Agad-agad. Ligtas tayo roon nang magkasama.

translations.EN: I'll get it ready for both of us.
translations.TL: Ihahanda ko para sa ating dalawa.

translations.EN: Trust your judgment completely. Camp is going up.
translations.TL: Lubos akong nagtitiwala sa pasya mo. Itatayo na ang kampo.

translations.EN: Setting up camp. We earned this rest.
translations.TL: Nagtatayo ng kampo. Karapat-dapat tayo sa pahingang ito.

translations.EN: Good call, partner. I'll secure the camp perimeter.
translations.TL: Magandang pasya, kasama. Seselyuhan ko ang paligid ng kampo.

translations.EN: I'll set up camp there.
translations.TL: Magtatayo ako ng kampo roon.

translations.EN: Fine. Heading over to camp.
translations.TL: Sige. Pupunta roon para magkampo.

translations.EN: Understood. Camping.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Magkakampo.

translations.EN: If you say so. I'll make camp.
translations.TL: Kung sinasabi mo. Magtatayo ako ng kampo.

translations.EN: Going to set it up now.
translations.TL: Pupunta para itayo ngayon.

translations.EN: All right. Pitching shelter.
translations.TL: Sige. Magtatayo ng silong.

translations.EN: I'll do it.
translations.TL: Gagawin ko.

translations.EN: Making camp. Leave me to it.
translations.TL: Nagtatayo ng kampo. Hayaan mo na ako rito.

translations.EN: Fine. Camping there.
translations.TL: Sige. Magkakampo roon.

translations.EN: Heard. Setting up.
translations.TL: Narinig ko. Nagtatayo na.

translations.EN: I can't set up camp there right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makapag-set up ng kampo roon ngayon.

translations.EN: That spot is far too dangerous to sleep in.
translations.TL: Masyadong mapanganib ang pwestong 'yon para tulugan.

translations.EN: No way. It's crawling with dead over there.
translations.TL: Ayoko nga. Puno ng patay doon.

translations.EN: I refuse to camp in that area. Find somewhere safer.
translations.TL: Tumatanggi akong magkampo roon. Maghanap ng mas ligtas.

translations.EN: Too exposed. We'd get ambushed in our sleep.
translations.TL: Masyadong bukas. Matatambangan tayo habang natutulog.

translations.EN: Can't camp there. No walls, no fire, no cover.
translations.TL: Di makapagkampo roon. Walang pader, apoy, o silong.

translations.EN: Not camping there. That's asking to be eaten alive.
translations.TL: Di ako magkakampo roon. Parang nagpapakain tayo nang buhay.

translations.EN: Unable to comply. That position is totally compromised.
translations.TL: Di makasusunod. Masyadong dehado ang pwestong 'yan.

translations.EN: I won't bed down there. Pick another room.
translations.TL: Di ako hihiga roon. Pumili ka ng ibang kwarto.

translations.EN: Camping rejected. We need real security first.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang kampo. Kailangan natin ng tunay na kaligtasan.
